mathematical_change.summary: In the partner's sole mixed exact-rank-three regime s3<3/5<s2, the one-heavy/two-light Pluecker mass is at least 9/25. Hence one heavy original row has a transverse light Gram G satisfying (1/25)I<=G<=I. If a normalized transverse light leverage is at least 1/32, the partner pair compression/pivot/near-null theorem pays the full density by <8228. Otherwise MSS partitions the light originals into two disjoint independent banks with transverse Grams each between (7/32)G and (25/32)G, in particular each >=7/800 I.

next_step: Use both disjoint product-linear transverse banks jointly with the heavy scalar. In the near-null heavy-pivot regime, average the rank-two logarithmic ridge against the second bank before taking absolute values or reciprocal coefficients; do not replace either bank by an arbitrary two-dimensional density. Arbitrary additional spectrum remains separate debt.
